Title: MemorySearchOptions Model
Summary: Options model for configuring memory search behavior including keywords, category filtering, result limits, and relevance thresholds.
Content:
## MemorySearchOptions

**Namespace:** `Cyrena.LTM.Models`

**Type:** `public class`

Options for searching long-term memories.

### Properties

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `Keywords` | `string[]` | `[]` | Keywords to search for. Memories matching more keywords receive a higher search score |
| `CategoryId` | `string?` | `null` | Optional category ID to restrict search. When null, searches across all categories |
| `MaxResults` | `int?` | `null` | Maximum number of results to return. Null returns all results |
| `MinRelevance` | `double?` | `null` | Minimum relevance score threshold (0-1). Results below this are excluded |

### Usage Example

```csharp
var options = new MemorySearchOptions
{
    Keywords = ["project", "deadline"],
    CategoryId = "work-memories",
    MaxResults = 10,
    MinRelevance = 0.3
};

var results = await memoryService.SearchAsync(options);
```
